caveats.non_comparability_warning: Comparing the extractor's 0.5952 with the direct-answer arm's 0.6143 would be WRONG. The extractor emits a metric CLASS, and the class 'hexagonal_or_trigonal' is scored correct against EITHER true label, because a cell metric cannot separate that pair at any precision. The models are scored on a strict 7-way label. So the comparison would pit a 6-way-with-a-free-pass task against a 7-way one.

caveats.margin_is_not_a_rounding_artifact: the 0.0021 shortfall must not be waived: the error distribution is bimodal (p25 0.007, p50 0.102, p75 0.497; 33.5% within 2% of truth, 39.6% more than 25% off). A median sitting on the threshold while two-fifths of measurements are off by more than a quarter is not a measuring instrument.
